title: Dreadful thirst
html_source:
Allusion to James Thomson’s poem with a solid summary here from the BBC.Signifies the gutter for Stephen’s self and soul. The poem relentlessly delves into a desolate city, not hell, but the end of anything : ‘With weary tread /each wrapt in his own doom, they wander, wander /or sit foredone and desolately ponder’.

This is it,the dénouement. Stephen, it has come to this point, your delusions are morphing, by Proteus' will into rancid sludge, one sodden grain of your soul at a time. The youthful attempts to raise yourself onto a gifted pedestal above this allrot have failed. Return ashore to your cage !
